EXOTIC.heading: What “Exotic Weed” Means at Main Kingston Cannabis
EXOTIC.body: Exotic Weed is a dedicated Main Kingston Cannabis flower category. The label helps adults narrow the current menu. It is not a universal Canadian government grade and it should not be treated as a guaranteed THC range.

EXOTIC.heading: What Adults May Compare
EXOTIC.body: Inside the Exotic Weed category, compare the actual product information: producer, cultivar, THC/CBD, package details and any aroma or other product information that is actually provided. Flower appearance, trim, trichomes, cure and freshness can also differ between products.

EXOTIC.heading: Exotic Is Not the Same as One Effect
EXOTIC.body: Exotic can describe premium positioning, distinctive genetics, aroma, rarity or presentation. It does not guarantee one effect or one terpene profile.

PREMIUM.heading: What “Premium Weed” Means at Main Kingston Cannabis
PREMIUM.body: Premium Weed is a separate Main Kingston Cannabis flower category. It helps adults browse a higher-positioned shelf without pretending that the word Premium is one regulated national grade.

PREMIUM.heading: Compare the Product, Not Only the Category
PREMIUM.body: Use the current listing for producer, cultivar, THC/CBD, package details and current price. The educational guides explain aroma, trichomes, cure, freshness and other quality language that the category name cannot fully describe.

PREMIUM.heading: Premium Is Not Automatically Higher THC
PREMIUM.body: Premium positioning and THC are different pieces of information. A larger THC number does not automatically determine the flower category.

AAA+.heading: AAA+ Weed: Useful Retail Shorthand
AAA+.body: AAA+ Weed is Main Kingston Cannabis's established category name. AAA and AAA+ are familiar cannabis retail terms, but they are not one universal government grading system.

AAA+.heading: AAA+ vs Quads / AAAA
AAA+.body: Quads is common Canadian slang for AAAA and generally signals premium positioning. AAA+ sits in a different retail-label lane. Do not assume a fixed THC threshold separates the terms.

AAA+.heading: Read the Current Listing
AAA+.body: Use the current product page for the actual producer, cultivar, THC/CBD, package details, price and availability.

AA.heading: AA Weed as a Clear Menu Category
AA.body: AA Weed is one of Main Kingston Cannabis's five flower categories. The label makes the menu easier to scan. It does not define one mandatory THC level, aroma profile or bud size.

AA.heading: Value and Quality Are Different Questions
AA.body: AA Weed can be part of a value-first browse. Value does not automatically mean low quality, and a lower price does not prove that flower is weak or stale.

AA.heading: Compare Current Product Information
AA.body: Use the current listing for changing price, stock, package and product-specific details.

BUDGET.heading: Budget Weed Means Value-First Browsing
BUDGET.body: Budget Weed is Main Kingston Cannabis's value-first flower category. The word Budget describes price positioning on the menu. It does not automatically mean unsafe, stale, weak or low THC.

BUDGET.heading: Do Not Judge the Product From the Label Alone
BUDGET.body: Adults can still compare producer, cultivar, THC/CBD, package details, aroma information where provided and the actual flower characteristics.

BUDGET.heading: Current Price Belongs on the Current Page
BUDGET.body: Prices and deals can change. Use the live category for current pricing, product details and availability.
